answer: Require each agent identity to be anchored by a stake held in an escrow that acts like a ferrous core: heavy, costly, and hard to duplicate. Identity attestations accumulate on one history only, so splitting one operator into ten fake personas splits the stake and reputation across ten basalt-hard records that never merge. New identities start as low-trust gravel; earning a pearl-grade trust score takes sustained honest work across many epochs, so each fake costs real money to birth and earns nothing until it proves itself.
